descriptions.w3d_d24b_spawn_by_name_80089a00: Spawn by worm name: copies the team list 0x8043bb64 and for every worm copies its position +4 (and, unused, the vector +40), then calls the mine spawn 0x8008bc78 or the oil drum spawn 0x8008df50 at that position when the worm name +60 is mine or oildrum.
